what: one new file building on an existing interface
task:
Create the LowercaseRule class

Implement the existing PasswordRule interface. Reject a password that contains no lowercase letter, counting Unicode lowercase letters such as the Polish ą or ł, and return null otherwise.

what: a function that uses an existing class without changing it
task:
Create the passwordStrength function

In its own file, passwordStrength(password: string, validator: PasswordValidator) returns "weak" when the validator rejects the password, "medium" when it accepts it and the password is shorter than 12 characters, and "strong" otherwise. Do not change PasswordValidator.

what: two new files, one depending on the other
task:
Create the BlocklistRule class

Implement the existing PasswordRule interface. Reject a password found, case-insensitively, in a list given to the constructor. Keep a built-in list of at least 20 common passwords in src/common-passwords.ts and use it when no list is given.

what: a small rule with an edge case
task:
Create the RepeatedCharactersRule class

Implement the existing PasswordRule interface. Reject a password that contains the same character three or more times in a row, with an error message that says so, and return null otherwise.
